business: OliveIQ: a Greek-language olive-grove logbook web app with δάκος alerts and an OPEKEPE-ready PDF
target: People in Greece who keep (or must keep) records for olive groves: family growers with a few hundred trees, full-time olive producers, and the agronomists / ΚΥΔ consultants who keep field diaries and file ΟΣΔΕ for many growers. All money is in euros.
where: Greece: Peloponnese (Messinia, Lakonia), Crete, Western Greece

segments.name: Family olive grower (part-time, about 100-400 trees, also has another job or a pension)
Full-time olive producer (about 1,000-3,000 trees, oil is the main income)
Agronomist or ΚΥΔ consultant who keeps diaries and files ΟΣΔΕ for 50-300 growers

behaviours.name: Paper and memory
behaviours.how: Keeps work and costs in a notebook or in their head; has never paid for an app.

behaviours.name: Leans on the agronomist or cooperative
behaviours.how: Lets the consultant, the cooperative or the mill handle records and paperwork.

behaviours.name: Already uses another tool
behaviours.how: Already pays for or uses something like gaiasense, CropApp or OliveSuite, or the ΚΥΔ's own software.

behaviours.name: Tech-comfortable
behaviours.how: Uses a smartphone for everything, tries new apps, uses e-banking and myAADE without help.

behaviours.name: Price-tight
behaviours.how: Counts every euro after a bad harvest or low oil price; cancels anything not clearly paying back.

behaviours.name: Subsidy-driven
behaviours.how: Decides tools and practices by what the ΚΑΠ eco-schemes pay for.

behaviours.name: Trusts neighbours and ΔΑΟΚ
behaviours.how: Sprays for δάκος when the ΔΑΟΚ programme or the neighbours do; learns about tools at the καφενείο.

objections: I don't have time to type every job into an app
The ΔΑΟΚ and the agronomist already tell me when there is δάκος
Will OPEKEPE or my accountant actually accept this PDF?
Is it certified for the eco-scheme (31.6)? If not, it's useless for my clients
Another subscription, for a crop that pays once a year
I already use another app or the ΚΥΔ's software
Who is behind this, and will it still exist next year?
habits: you go to the grove at weekends and during harvest in November-December
you deliver olives to the local mill and keep the slips in a drawer
in spring the ΟΣΔΕ filing season takes over your weeks
you check the weather on your phone every morning
you talk about prices and δάκος with others at the καφενείο
you work from a small office in town and drive out to clients' groves
